# Noyis Africa

> Wholesale & retail warehouse in St. John's, Antigua & Barbuda. Natural wellness, herbal formulas, functional beverages and commercial drinks distributed across the Caribbean, the US, Canada and Latin America.

Tagline: Your Health, Our Priority.

Noyis Africa supplies premium herbal formulas (Treasure Man, Treasure Woman, Treasure Herbs), functional coffees, Caribbean herbal teas, and wholesale beverage cartons (Coca-Cola, Malta, juices) to consumers, retailers, and distributors. Orders are placed via WhatsApp — no online checkout required.
